name: SIS 04 — Results Approval and Publication — Complete

nodes.name: Marks Decision Webhook
nodes.notes: Authenticated staff portal endpoint for approving, rejecting or returning a finalized marks batch.

nodes.name: Correction Decision Webhook
nodes.notes: Authenticated staff portal endpoint for approving/applying or rejecting a mark-correction request.

nodes.name: Publish Results Webhook
nodes.notes: Authenticated staff portal endpoint for idempotent course-result publication.

nodes.name: Normalize Staff Results Request
nodes.notes: Normalizes all three staff webhook operations and accepts only an Authorization bearer token plus an allowlisted RPC name.

nodes.name: Is Staff Request Structurally Valid?
nodes.notes: Rejects malformed requests before any Supabase user lookup or business RPC call.

nodes.name: Verify Supabase Staff Session
nodes.notes: Validates the incoming Supabase access token with the Auth user endpoint. The service-role credential is not used for this identity check.

nodes.name: Build Verified Staff RPC Request
nodes.notes: Overwrites all browser-supplied requester fields with the user ID and email returned by Supabase Auth.

nodes.name: Is Staff Identity Verified?
nodes.notes: Only verified Supabase sessions can reach a service-role business RPC.

nodes.name: Call Results Business RPC
nodes.notes: Calls only the allowlisted results RPC selected by the normalized operation. Database authorization and idempotency remain authoritative.

nodes.name: Build Staff Webhook Response
nodes.notes: Returns only the stable RPC success/failure contract and never exposes provider errors, SQL or tokens.

nodes.name: Reject Invalid Staff Request
nodes.notes: Sanitized terminal response for malformed or unsupported staff requests.

nodes.name: Mark Correction Queue Trigger
nodes.notes: Polls only newly appended Automation Queue rows from the Mark Correction Request response spreadsheet.

nodes.name: Normalize Correction Queue Row
nodes.notes: Normalizes the Mark Correction Request form and converts deterministic validation failures into durable queue outcomes.

nodes.name: Is Correction Queue Row Processable?
nodes.notes: Processes only pending marks.correction.request rows and ignores already handled or unrelated queue rows.

nodes.name: Is Correction Request Ready?
nodes.notes: Routes valid form requests to Supabase and validation failures directly to the queue update.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Correction Queue Row').item.json.request.correlation_id, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Correction Queue Row').item.json.request.idempotency_key + ':workflow-start', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{ 'workflow_code':'04-results-publication', 'n8n_execution_id':$execution.id, 'operation':'marks.correction.request', 'run_status':'started', 'input_summary':{'form_response_id':$('Normalize Correction Queue Row').item.json.queue.formResponseId,'marks_batch_id':$('Normalize Correction Queue Row').item.json.request.payload.marks_batch_id,'student_mark_id':$('Normalize Correction Queue Row').item.json.request.payload.student_mark_id} } } } }}

nodes.name: Log Correction Workflow Start
nodes.notes: Best-effort start evidence. A logging outage cannot block the correction request.

nodes.name: Submit Correction Request RPC
nodes.notes: Calls the service-role-only form wrapper, which resolves codes, verifies teacher/admin scope and validates the referenced mark.

nodes.name: Build Correction Queue Outcome
nodes.notes: Converts the RPC result into sanitized queue fields and increments retries only for explicitly retryable failures.

nodes.name: Update Correction Automation Queue
nodes.notes: Updates exactly one Automation Queue row by immutable Form Response ID.

nodes.name: Log Correction Workflow Completion
nodes.notes: Best-effort completion evidence. Queue durability remains authoritative if operational logging is unavailable.

nodes.name: Skip Non-Pending Correction Queue Row
nodes.notes: Terminal node for already processed or unrelated queue rows.
